load_hand_model_from_file: load a UmeTrack hand model from a JSON file and convert millimeter positions to meters
create_UmeTrackHandDataProvider: create a UmeTrackHandDataProvider from hand pose trajectory and hand profile JSON file paths
get_hand_mesh_vertices: get the skinned hand mesh vertices tensor for a given HandPose with wrist and joint data
get_hand_landmarks: get the hand joint landmark positions for a given HandPose using bone skinning weights
skin_vertices: skin mesh vertices using a hand model, joint angles, and optional wrist transform matrix
